identification: Small (H-8 cm) brown and amber drip glazed McHugh vase, squat bulbous form with flared rim. Base incised 'H. McHugh Tasmania', a date that I read as 1934 (the scan said 1924 but McHugh dating of this type began in the early 1930s, so 1934 is far more likely; a 1920s date is unproven) and shape number 26. Typical 1930s McHugh, not an early piece.

searches_tried: comps.py (pipeline) 'McHugh vase' and 'small mchugh'; work/comps.py 'McHugh' and 'mchugh vase' with max-price; one WebSearch for dated 1924 McHugh (found no 1924 example; dates seen are 1930s-1950s; marking with date began early 1930s). Armitage and Gowans past results cover the same buyer pool. Small signed McHugh vases of 7-13 cm hammer mostly $15-$95, median about $35-45; only unusual or larger pieces reach $130-$200+. eBay sold would add little.
viewing_check: Check the base date under good light: is it 1924 or 1934 (a genuine 1920s date would add real value and should be photographed). Check the foot rim and mouth for the chip and any crazing or hairlines.
